anatomy: Alert: the crafted content banner (95:785): r12, <tone>/subtle fill, no stroke, no material or shadow; padding 13/14/14/14 and gap 10 (literal, the 44px one-line banner); 16px glyph in the Apple system hue (neutral liquid/tag/gray, info liquid/accent/system, success /green, warning /orange, destructive /red, important /purple); label Medium 13/17 text/fg; description text/muted; action Liquid/Button sm link (primary/text); close Liquid/Icon button xs secondary (material/track circle, the L.close motif). strong (derived): the same banner plus a 1px <tone>/border rim and the label in <tone>/text Semi Bold; base rule hidden.

Inline notice: DESIGN 'status is a 7px dot plus a word': opaque surface/muted platter row at r8, no stroke; glyph part kept hidden, a theme-only 7px 'dot' in the hue sits in the icon box (icon boolean); word text/fg Medium, description text/muted; Liquid/Button xs link, Liquid/Icon button xs secondary.

Toast: L.float bar weight copied from Liquid/Action bar floating (liquid/material/glass-float, specular-tint rim, 0.5 outline, top highlight, inner glow 20, 0 8 24 shadow, GLASS); radius 22; root padding 0/14, content 14/2. Tone = glyph hue (default text/muted, loading Liquid/Spinner) and the timer bar (default/loading liquid/accent/system); title text/fg, message text/muted; action Liquid/Button sm link; close Liquid/Icon button xs secondary. Timer: 3px full-pill material/track rail inset 16, theme-only timer-gap 12 (visible = progress).

Progress: macOS bar: full-pill material/track rail 4/6/8 (sm/md/lg) with a full-pill fill (primary liquid/accent/system, secondary text/muted, status liquid/tag/green|orange|red); label L.body 13/17 text/fg; value font/sans (no mono). Value still = track padding.
Progress circular (derived): material/track ring, round-capped arc in the same hues, strokes 2/3/4; value font/sans.
Skeleton: material/track bones (reads on content and glass); lines and avatars radius/control (pills, circles), blocks radius/card 14.

Skeleton preset: table = the Liquid table (30 header with the liquid/state/hover-overlay hairline, 40 rows at r8, zebra surface/muted on even rows, no row rules); stats = KPI platters (surface/muted, radius/card, no stroke); detail/form keep the base bone layout (no container in base). Bones are Liquid/Skeleton.

Empty state: border on = an opaque platter (surface/muted, radius/card 14, no stroke, dashes removed); media a 40 material/track circle with the glyph in liquid/accent/system (first-use), text/muted (no-results), liquid/tag/red (error); image media r12; title L.window-title text/fg, description text/muted; actions Liquid/Button md primary (L.prominent) + secondary (material/track pill).

ownerReview: Status hues: Alert/Toast glyphs, Inline notice dots and Progress fills use the Apple system hues (liquid/tag/*), as the theme's status dots and nav tints do. As graphics they are below 3:1 on the tinted fills in Light (e.g. orange #ff9500 on warning/subtle); the tone word or label carries the meaning. Same trade-off as the table status dots.

Alert subtle and strong both use the tinted banner (the crafted 95:785 look); strong adds the tone rim and a Semi Bold tone label. The one-line banner keeps the action under the label (the base body column), not inline at the right as in the crafted banner.
Inline notice is a neutral platter with a dot and a word, not a tinted row: Liquid's documented status language. Toasts are float glass (tone only in the glyph and the timer).

Screens: the Liquid Top bar shows its fixture window title 'Orders · 3,182 orders · last 30 days' on every screen (not driven by props), like the Cupertino large title was. Screens sit on the flat page background, not on a wallpaper, so the glass reads as translucent grey; DESIGN asks for a desktop behind glass.

Dark-screen audit note: 8 secondary Icon buttons in the dark screens were flagged by an opacity diff that is only the mode-dependent alpha of material/track (12% Light / 24% Dark), not an override; their fills were reassigned to the same bound role. A bound paint takes the variable's alpha at render (confirmed in the Bloom pass: a 25% paint opacity on a bound role rendered opaque), so the Dark alpha is unchanged.
